Listed as not public since 25 Sep 2026; now public in the register. WK 14487/26 ADD 1: Clean version of the Presidency's first compromise text on Title IV (security of ICT supply chains, Articles 98-117) of the CSA2 proposal, WK 14487/26 ADD 1 of 22 September 2026, sent by the Presidency to the Horizontal Working Party on Cyber Issues; a draft, not law, which the Council has released only in part.

entry.title: Council releases 3 Digital Omnibus documents
entry.summary: 1 compromise text, 2 notes: Presidency revised compromise text; Steering and Explanatory Note by the Presidency - AGS meeting on 25 September 2026; Non-paper from Poland on Digital Omnibus provisions concerning cookies. Listed as not public since 26 Sep 2026; now public in the register. ST 13112/26: Presidency revised compromise text of 21 September 2026 (ST 13112/26) on the Digital Omnibus, circulated by the General Secretariat of the Council for the meeting of the Antici Group (Simplification) of 25 September 2026; it is the Presidency's text, not a Council position, and can still change.
